reviewItem.question: For "Standardization of the peer metadata attributes: CEL expressions in the telemetry API must use the standard Envoy attributes instead of the custom Wasm…", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

exposure.needed: whether any Telemetry API CEL expressions use the old attributes (filter_state["wasm.downstream_peer"], filter_state["wasm.upstream_peer"], node, or unqualified wasm attributes such as istio_responseClass)

proposed.statement: Telemetry API CEL expressions must be updated to use standard Envoy attributes (filter_state.downstream_peer/upstream_peer, xds.node, fully qualified wasm.* attributes) instead of the custom Wasm extended attributes.
